Source filenames are preserved as campaign keys; build_master.py reads this file when the loose JSONs are absent. Checkpoint guide: CHECKPOINTS.md. Inventory: checkpoints_manifest.tsv.

published_audit.protocol: chronological 7:3 split; scaler fit on train; lookback 192; test windows start at n-n_test-192 (TSLib convention); MSE averaged over all horizons steps and channels

findings: Protocol (settled by the DLinear campaign, verified against the real Time-Series-Library): 70/10/20 chronological split, per-channel z-scoring on the training span, raw-PSD reporting (TSLib --inverse), lr 5e-3 with the type1 halving schedule, 10 epochs, patience 3, seed 2021.

The published Time-LLM tables reproduce under one protocol, each under its own channel mode: 4ch row = all-channel (1.006x), 25ch row = channel-independent (0.968x). The article's equation (all-channel) contradicts the code that produced its 25-channel table.
All-channel fails at 25 channels architecturally: 1.39x (d32) to 1.45x (d64) vs CI -- widening the token does not help, so it is the channel entanglement, not a width bottleneck.
DLinear: 8 of 10 published cells verified against the real TSLib; both published K=96 cells are unreproducible under any single protocol (the 4ch one is a printing error with high confidence).
Seed noise of the Time-LLM protocol: mostly 0.5-5% CV, 25ch CI under 1%, but 4ch all-channel K=96 swings 0.30-0.41. Single-seed comparisons are fragile; judge against bands.
BERT diverges at K=192 in both scenarios under this schedule; OFA overshoots the published 4ch row by 12% (unexplained; possibly run all-channel).
Checkpoint audit: every verbatim-prompt file reproduces its recorded test MSE bit-exactly; old-prompt files re-score within 0.2-1.5% because the prompt template lives in the code, not the checkpoint.

reeval_runs.json.description: First campaign (150 runs): literal split, seeds 0-4, Time-LLM gpt2/bert/random, 4/25/151 channels. Weights deleted locally, live in object storage at checkpoints/repro/spectrumllm/literal/; this file is their ONLY metrics record. Each value was re-evaluated bit-exact before the weights were removed.

results_split_study.json.description: The split study (6 runs): 25ch CI, literal K=12 then the full tslib campaign -- the runs that settled the 70/10/20 reading. Old prompt vintage.

res4_all_match.json.description: 4ch all-channel, tslib, capacity-matched d_model 64 / d_ff 128 (5 runs). Old prompt vintage.

res4_ci_dm32.json.description: 4ch channel-independent, tslib, d_model 32 (5 runs). Old prompt vintage; superseded by results_n4_ci_d32_tslib.json but its weights are in the manifest.

results_n25_all_tslib.json.description: 25ch all-channel, tslib, d_model 32, seeds 0/1/2 (15 runs) -- the only multi-seed campaign; source of the seed-variance bands. Old prompt vintage.

results_dlinear_settled.json.description: Canonical DLinear: the exact Time-Series-Library protocol (70/10/20, std training, lr 5e-3 type1, 10 epochs, patience 3, seed 2021). 8 of 10 published cells reproduce within the protocol's own seed band.

results_n4_all_d32_tslib.json.description: 4ch all-channel, tslib, d32 -- THE 4-channel reproduction cell: mean ratio 1.006 to the published Time-LLM (GPT-2) row. Verbatim prompt.

results_n25_all_d32_tslib.json.description: 25ch all-channel, tslib, d32 (ratio 1.144) -- the architectural failure cell: no prompt or width rescues the entangled token at N=25. Verbatim prompt.

results_n25_ci_d32_tslib.json.description: 25ch channel-independent, tslib, d32 -- THE 25-channel reproduction cell: mean ratio 0.968 to the published row. Verbatim prompt.

results_n25_all_d64_tslib.json.description: 25ch all-channel, tslib, d64/ff128 -- the width test: widening does NOT close the all-channel penalty (1.45x vs CI), so the failure is architectural. Verbatim prompt.

results_n4_ofa_ci_tslib.json.description: OFA (GPT4TS), 4ch CI, tslib (ratio 0.885 -- the one unexplained overshoot; their OFA row may have been all-channel). Verbatim prompt.

results_n25_ofa_ci_tslib.json.description: OFA (GPT4TS), 25ch CI, tslib (ratio 0.956 -- matches published). Verbatim prompt.

results_n4_bert_ci_tslib.json.description: Time-LLM BERT, 4ch CI, tslib. Matches at K=12-96; K=192 diverged (0.794 vs published 0.344) -- a real BERT training instability at the longest horizon.

results_n25_bert_ci_tslib.json.description: Time-LLM BERT, 25ch CI, tslib. Matches at K=12-96 (0.93-0.97); K=192 diverged (1.551, worse than persistence) -- same instability.

res4_all_dm32.json.description: 4ch all-channel, tslib, d_model 32 (5 runs). Old prompt vintage. Its weights were overwritten by the capacity-matched d64 run (the chunk-id collision); the metrics remain as the d32 side of the width comparison (0.2891 vs d64's 0.3052 at 4ch).
